headline: World Egg Day
Four-egg omelets
altText: Garbage Can omelet loaded with meats, veggies and American cheese
Wild Western omelet with home fries

instagram.text:
Happy World Egg Day.

We celebrate with four eggs at a time. The Garbage Can Omelet comes loaded with bacon, sausage, ham, onions, peppers, tomatoes, mushrooms and American cheese. The Wild Western brings smoked applewood ham, onions and green peppers.

People drive in from Melbourne for these. Open today 7am-2pm.

321.338.2909
www.MitchellsCocoa.com

headline: Weekend brunch
Mimosas are poured
altText: Two mimosas garnished with fresh strawberries
Berries and cream waffle with strawberries and blueberries

instagram.text:
Saturday brunch is on.

Mimosas by the glass or the pitcher, and a fresh-made waffle piled with strawberries, blueberries and whipped cream to go with them.

We're open 7am-2pm. Bring the crew.

21+. Please drink responsibly.
